[SWS_CRYPT_20905] Verify
⌈
The X.509 Provider shall verify if a certifi-
cate is valid. Therefore, the X.509 Provider checks additionally if a certificate was
revoked, The revocation of the certificate is given via the CRL. This check can either be
done via a call by an application or functional cluster (offline mode) or via a connection
to a backend (online mode):
• In offline mode: An application or functional cluster provides the CRL to the X.-
509 Provider via an interface, which is exposed by the CryptoAPI.
• in online mode: The X.509 Provider uses a provided location to get the CRL.
The location was provided by configuration or given in the interface call.
In both cases, the X.509 Provider uses the CRL to check if one of the internal stored
certificate is listed. Is a certificate listed the X.509 Provider revokes the certificate
internally.
⌋
